{{Quote|Wutzek is a demon, a Force creature of unimaginable power. It's believed that long ago his kind owned the universe...|[[Suzal]]|<ref name="TPE" />}}
'''Wutzek''' was the last remaining [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Demon/Legends|demon]] known to exist during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. A member of an extremely powerful [[Species/Legends|race]] that were believed to have once ruled [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in its [[Pre-Republic era|distant past]]. Wutzek was captured by an evil-worshipping cult called the [[Five]], which [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] him for [[Standard year/Legends|centuries]] as a curiosity aboard their [[Five's warship|warship]] within the [[Hellhoop/Legends|Hellhoop]] but was able to escape during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] with the aid of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] sometime between [[0 ABY/Legends|0]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], and proceeded to swiftly destroy any trace of the Five.

==Biography==
{{Quote|How frail your flesh, my tormentors. How transient. And now that it is gone, only your souls survive... within me. Forever.|Wutzek, after slaughtering the Five|<ref name="TPE" />}}
An extremely powerful and ancient [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Demon/Legends|demon]], Wutzek belonged to a race that once ruled [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during its distant past. However, by the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Wutzek was the last of his kind. Wutzek was eventually captured by a reclusive evil-worshipping cult known as the [[Five]], which resided deep within the region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] known as the [[Hellhoop/Legends|Hellhoop]]. The Five [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] Wutzek inside an [[angle trap]] held in their [[Five's warship|warship's]] recreation room, along with a number of other curiosities they had collected in their time living within the Hellhoop.<ref name="TPE" />

Wutzek bided his time for [[Standard year/Legends|centuries]] for a chance to escape&mdash;it finally came between [[0 ABY/Legends|0]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], when the Five imprisoned [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] leaders [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. While the Five planned to [[Torture/Legends|torture]] and [[Death/Legends|kill]] Organa and Solo like they did so many other unfortunate travelers, they did not recognize the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] Chewbacca as anything more than an unintelligent [[Ape/Legends|ape]], and placed him with Wutzek in their recreation room. Sensing opportunity, Wutzek [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathically]] convinced Chewbacca to free him from his trap, and the unleashed demon swiftly proceeded to brutally kill and absorb the [[Soul/Legends|souls]] of his former captors. Wutzek repaid the rebels who helped save him by allowing them to go free before he completely destroyed the Five's [[Starship/Legends|ship]], before resuming his free reign over the galaxy.<ref name="TPE" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|It's his pride that's hurt. He's the last of his kind, you see. All that power, all that intelligence...|Suzal|<ref name="TPE" />}}
Once an all-powerful being, extremely intelligent with amazing destructive power, Wutzek found himself outwitted by the Five, who managed to imprison him in an angle trap. His pride sorely wounded, a scornful and humiliated Wutzek stayed silent for years, hoping for a chance at revenge. Wutzek had the ability to reach into nearby [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]]' minds telepathically and show images and memories from his past, which he used to help convince Chewbacca to free him&mdash;Wutzek reveled in the violence that followed, as he had missed killing after such a long time imprisoned. However, Wutzek felt an unfamiliar emotion after destroying the Five: gratitude towards his rescuers, which he repaid by allowing them to escape before consuming the Five's ship. Wutzek appeared akin to a large, [[Color|blue white]] cloud, shifting and swirling with light.<ref name="TPE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wutzek appeared in ''[[The Pandora Effect]]'', a [[1981]] comic story written by [[Alan Moore]] and published in [[The Empire Strikes Back Monthly 151|''The Empire Strikes Back Monthly'' 151]]. In the story, Wutzek was drawn by [[Adolfo Buylla]].<ref name="TPE" />
